name: belt-pi
description: belt's guards and hints as a pi package: pi loads extensions/*.ts in place from this directory (the ralph sources cache on a machine). permission-gate.ts runs belt check before each tool call and fails closed, belt-hooks.ts appends belt hint advice, permission-broker.ts carries headless confirmations to the root TUI. Settings come from belt.json in pi's agent directory (lib/config.ts).
